Package com.j3d.ui.theme.updator

Class Locator

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.ui.theme.updator.Locator
public final class Locator extends Object
A utility class that acts as a locator for a specific theme property and its corresponding setter function. This class is typically used in UI theme management systems to associate a theme property (e.g., a color defined in J3DTheme) with a method that can apply that colour to a UI component.

It provides methods to access and modify the associated theme property and its setter.

Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
